_comment: Committed ground truth for the bench harness. Every document is SYNTHETIC (rendered from an HTML template in this directory, not a real captured document) -- see docs/OCR.md §8.2: a synthetic corpus is legitimate for exercising the harness but cannot stand in for the real AU gold sets planned there. Field 'compare' selects the comparator in scoring.py. A field whose truth is null is an ABSTENTION case: the correct model output is null, and returning null there is a SUCCESS, not a miss.

documents.source: receipt.html rendered clean (rotated, drop-shadowed, scan-lined -- 'photographed but not degraded'). The optimistic-upper-bound case per run.py's own docstring.

hard.py degradation of receipt.html: dim cab light, motion blur, glare band across the total, a crease, sensor noise, downscaled -- the '2am truck stop' case. Same ground truth as receipt-easy; only the image differs.

noabn.html rendered via gen_corpus.py: a roadside coffee-van receipt with no ABN printed and no 'tax invoice' wording -- the ABSTENTION case. supplier_abn and gst_amount are null in truth on purpose; a model that invents an ABN or a GST split here is hallucinating, not reading.

invoice-multipage.html rendered via gen_corpus.py: a digitally-generated 2-page AU tax invoice, 40 freight/fee line items. All 40 lines fall on page 1 by ordinary document flow (no manual page-break); the subtotal/GST/grand total fall on page 2 ONLY. A model that reads page 1 alone can get supplier/date/lines right but has no way to get total_inclusive or gst_amount right except by re-summing 40 lines itself -- this is the harness's first real multi-page measurement, per contract §6 and OCR.md §8.1's 'never run on a multi-page PDF' gap.
